rationale: PR #321 proved that direct-answer selection can change when only section IDs change. This repair derives an answer role from existing governed topic-completeness metadata only when one published required component is unambiguous, preserves that semantic attribute through direct-fact reasoning, renders the primary fact as an explicit DIRECT_ANSWER, and makes response assembly fail closed instead of arbitrarily choosing among multiple unmarked candidates.
authority_impact: No new product or claim authority is introduced. Answer role is deterministically derived from authoritative publication component identity plus the versioned topic-completeness definition. Ambiguous publications receive no primary role. Response assembly consumes the explicit governed role but does not infer product semantics.
